summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only test of ThinkToUnlock v1.2 (emoji Icon, Premium Hub, 5 manager screens, simplified Manage tab, Smart Reminders toggle, AsyncStorage v2). 19/21 tested items PASS. One CRITICAL runtime bug found in game start screen (state-not-defined → red screen, blocks entire reward flow), and a stray-syntax issue in /app/frontend/app/game/[id].tsx that I fixed. A second issue: pass-rate save does not appear to persist after navigating away (PARTIAL). Everything else works as specified.

ui_bugs.issue: RED SCREEN runtime error: 'Uncaught Error: state is not defined' at lines 37 and 66. The component destructures only `{ addWalletMinutes, recordHistory, incrementDailyChallenges }` from useAppState() but references `state.isPremium` and `state.passRatePercent`. This crashes the game start screen for every game card and breaks the entire reward / earn-time flow (spec item #8 'Game start screen shows the dynamic pass rate' fails).

After tapping a preset (e.g. 80%) and pressing 'Save Pass Rate', re-opening /premium-pass-rate still shows '60%' as the active rate with the 'tap save' caption (instead of 'currently active'). The new value does not appear to persist. Spec item #11 ('saved value reflected back') is PARTIAL.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot reach play stage; red screen on render. Knock-on impact: cannot validate spec items #13 (home wallet incremented on win), #15 (quota gating modal vs WhatsApp passthrough end-to-end) — at least the earn-time half cannot be exercised.

action_items: CRITICAL: In /app/frontend/app/game/[id].tsx line 18, change `const { addWalletMinutes, recordHistory, incrementDailyChallenges } = useAppState();` to `const { state, addWalletMinutes, recordHistory, incrementDailyChallenges } = useAppState();`. Lines 37 and 66 reference `state` without destructuring it, which red-screens the entire game start screen and breaks the earn-time flow.

HIGH: Verify pass-rate save handler in /app/frontend/app/premium-pass-rate.tsx — re-opening the screen after Save still shows the previously-active rate (60%) rather than the newly-saved one. Likely either (a) save is not awaited / state not committed before navigation, or (b) the displayed value reads from a local preview state rather than the persisted state.passRatePercent on mount.
MINOR (test ergonomics): Settings 'Premium Features' banner uses a star icon as a visual marker but no testID on the section header — fine, since the row testIDs cover routing.
COSMETIC: RN Web emits 'shadow*' style props deprecation warnings (carried over from earlier iterations) — migrate to boxShadow at convenience.
critical_code_review_comments: Icon.tsx is a clean drop-in replacement — no font dependency, supports all referenced glyphs, with reasonable emoji mapping. Static .font/.glyphMap stubs preserve compatibility with any leftover useFonts(Ionicons.font) calls.

storage.ts v2 schema and applySchedules() correctly: (a) reset dailyChallengesCompleted at midnight, (b) apply daily top-ups when scheduled time passed and lastApplied < scheduled, (c) apply weekly bonus only on weekends with weekKey gating, (d) reset weeklyTopupSec on weekdays, (e) merge defaultAppCfg into existing per-app entries on load to handle migration.

settings.tsx PREMIUM_FEATURES array drives all 5 rows; routing logic correctly funnels to /premium when not premium and to the per-feature manager when premium. Lock-closed → chevron-forward swap is clean.

game/[id].tsx had a stray block at lines 184–185 (`Items: 'center' },\n});`) that broke the entire web bundle (Metro SyntaxError 184:16) — every screen showed the Server Error overlay. rca_of_issue: TWO issues. (1) Build-blocker (FIXED by me): /app/frontend/app/game/[id].tsx ended with `});\nItems: 'center' },\n});` — a stray fragment of a StyleSheet entry was left after the closing `});` of StyleSheet.create. Metro reported `SyntaxError: Unexpected token (184:16)` and bundling failed for every route, so the user only ever saw the Server Error overlay. Reproduction: open any URL on the preview before fix → Server Error overlay. Mitigation: deleted the two stray lines so the StyleSheet ends cleanly at line 183 and restarted expo. (2) Runtime red-screen (NOT FIXED — requires main agent): game/[id].tsx imports `useAppState` and destructures `{ addWalletMinutes, recordHistory, incrementDailyChallenges }` only, but the JSX at line 66 (`{state.isPremium ? state.passRatePercent : 60}%`) and the pass-threshold logic at line 37 reference an undeclared `state`. This throws a ReferenceError on first render of the game start screen for ANY game. Reproduction: Setup password → Games tab → tap any game card → red screen 'state is not defined'. Mitigation: add `state` to the destructure: `const { state, addWalletMinutes, recordHistory, incrementDailyChallenges } = useAppState();`.
